Class StripeWebhookIntegrationServiceTest

@IsTest
private class StripeWebhookIntegrationServiceTest

Test class for StripeWebhookIntegrationService. Validates webhook signature verification, event processing, record creation via field mappings, post-processing method execution, sandbox validation logic, and error handling for various scenarios including invalid signatures, unsupported events, and data validation failures.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void executePostProcessingMethodsBlankClassNamesTest()

Tests executePostProcessingMethods() with blank/empty class names. Verifies that blank entries are skipped without error.

@IsTest
private static void executePostProcessingMethodsInvalidInterfaceTest()

Tests executePostProcessingMethods() with a class that doesn't implement the required interface. Verifies that the method logs an error and continues processing.

@IsTest
private static void executePostProcessingMethodsMultipleClassesPartialFailureTest()

Tests executePostProcessingMethods() with multiple classes where some fail. Verifies that failures in one processor don't prevent others from executing.

@IsTest
private static void executePostProcessingMethodsNonExistentClassTest()

Tests executePostProcessingMethods() with a non-existent class name. Verifies that the method logs an error via platform event and continues processing.

@IsTest
private static void executePostProcessingMethodsTest()

Tests the executePostProcessingMethods() functionality by verifying that post-processing methods defined in ReplicationSettings__mdt are executed after a record is saved. This test uses the PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor which is triggered by charge.succeeded events.

@IsTest
private static void executePostProcessingMethodsThrowsExceptionTest()

Tests executePostProcessingMethods() with a class that throws an exception during execution. Verifies that exceptions are caught, logged, and don't prevent other processors from running.

@IsTest
private static void sandboxValidationIgnoreFlagTest()

Tests that sandbox validation can be bypassed with the ignoreSandboxValidation flag. When ignoreSandboxValidation = true, test mode events should be accepted regardless of org type.

@IsTest
private static void sandboxValidationLivemodeEventTest()

Tests that a livemode event is accepted regardless of sandbox validation settings. When evt.livemode = true, the sandbox validation check should pass.

@IsTest
private static void sandboxValidationTestModeEventTest()

Tests sandbox validation behavior with test mode events. When evt.livemode = false and ignoreSandboxValidation = false, production orgs should reject test mode events with 403 status.

@IsTest
private static void syncCustomerDataErrorTest()

Tests error handling when customer sync fails due to data validation errors. Verifies that errors are logged and webhook returns 200 status.

@IsTest
private static void syncCustomerExceptionTest()

Tests exception handling when webhook processing encounters an unexpected error. Verifies that errors are logged and webhook returns 400 status.

@IsTest
private static void syncCustomerFailOtherEventTest()

Tests webhook handling for unsupported/unrecognized event types. Verifies that webhook returns 200 status but doesn't process unsupported events.

@IsTest
private static void syncCustomerSignatureFailureTest()

Tests signature validation failure with invalid signature. Verifies that webhook returns 401 status when signature doesn't match.

@IsTest
private static void syncCustomerSuccessTest1()

Tests successful customer sync with valid signature and webhook payload. Verifies that a customer.updated event creates or updates an Account record.

@IsTest
private static void syncCustomerSuccessTest2()

Tests successful customer sync with both signature and sandbox validation bypassed. Verifies that a customer.updated event is processed when validation flags are ignored.

@IsTest
private static void syncEmptyCustomerTest()

Tests customer sync with empty/blank customer data fields. Verifies that records with all empty fields are not created or updated.
